items.quote: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes
items.claim: Abraham addresses the LORD, describing himself as dust and ashes

items.quote: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five?
items.claim: Abraham questions whether God will destroy the city if five righteous people are lacking from fifty

items.quote: And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
items.claim: God states he will not destroy the city if he finds forty-five righteous people
